events.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going — do you need any help?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Uli: Thanks for asking, Mina. I’m managing for now, but I may need a hand if the bigger fixes come up.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mina: Sure — what kind of bigger fixes are you expecting?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I have to keep it quiet right now.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Leo: No worries — quiet help works. I’ll keep the repair drive low-key and send the details later.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I appreciate you keeping it low-key — send me the details when you can.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with setup and check-in for the repair drive. Just let me know when and where you need me.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Mara — that would help a lot. I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll send you the time and place once I know more.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Mara: Of course — just send the details when you have them, and I’ll be there to help.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Uli: A few bigger fixes might come up, but I’m keeping it low-key and sorting the details first. I’ll send you the time and place later.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Jules: Sounds good — send me the time and place when you’ve got them, and I’ll help spread the word.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — I appreciate that. I’ll send the time and place as soon as I’ve got them.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I can send over the timing details and help with setup if you’re able to join.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works — send the timing when you can, and I’ll keep it low-key.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli — I’ll send the timing details shortly, and thank you for keeping it low-key. I’m glad you can join us at the community center Sunday.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Faye: Sounds great — once the time’s locked in, I’ll repeat it to everyone so we’re all on the same page.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I’ll send the time and place once it’s set, and I appreciate you helping keep everyone in the loop.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Faye: Of course — send it over when you have it, and I’ll help fit it around pickup and drop-off.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Vik: Yep, I’ll spread the word and bring a couple broken things to fix. Send me the time once it’s locked in, and I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I could use quiet help with setup and check-in on Sunday at the community center. Send me the timing details when you can.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and bring a couple broken things that need fixing. I’ll check the timing and send it over as soon as I have it.
